text: やれやれ…　まったく　しょうがない　ヤツじゃのう　レッド！

structure.jp: まったく　しょうがない　ヤツじゃのう
structure.en: you really are a hopeless one, aren't you

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ, 'is'. ヤツじゃ = 'you are a fellow'.

patterns.name: 〜な (feeling)
patterns.explanation: のう is the old-man form of なあ, showing the speaker's feeling and looking for agreement. ヤツじゃのう = 'what a fellow you are, eh'.
